user.title: Location
user.description: Choose the observing location. Coordinates are validated against Open-Meteo before the integration is added.

preset.title: Scoring preset
preset.description: Choose how strict the scoring should be, and your preferred darkness for a usable night. The darkest chosen tier is used when it's reachable; otherwise the window falls back to a shallower one so a night is never skipped.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to contact Open-Meteo. Check the coordinates and try again.

init.title: Scoring preset
init.description: Step 1 of 6: pick the baseline preset. The following pages are prefilled from it -- keeping your current preset keeps your tuned values, switching to a different preset resets every tuning page to that preset's numbers.

night.title: Night type
night.description: Step 2 of 6: how dark does a night need to be? The darkest reachable tier in your chosen chain is used, falling back shallower so a night is never skipped.

cloud_thresholds.title: Cloud thresholds
cloud_thresholds.description: Step 3 of 6: hours at or below each ceiling score a perfect 100 for that cloud layer.

sky_thresholds.title: Sky and seeing thresholds
sky_thresholds.description: Step 4 of 6: 'ceiling' factors score 100 at or below their value; 'floor' factors (spread, visibility) score 100 at or above.

falloff_spans.title: Falloff spans
falloff_spans.description: Step 5 of 6: how far past each threshold the factor's score takes to fall from 100 to 0. Bigger span = gentler penalty.

weights.title: Factor weights
weights.description: Step 6 of 6: how much each factor matters, 0-5. They do not need to sum to anything -- scores normalize automatically.
